# CASEs with `tags` `individuation`

*Topics — What a work is about. Nucleation holds whatever reading the owner files here, whether or not an Anthology of the SOTA topic could also hold it; instruction for ML practice belongs to the anthology (ADR-048). The words are seeded from the clusters the reading-time triage of 2026-09-25 found, and grow by decision.*

**Individuation** — what makes something one thing, and the same thing over time or across descriptions — individuation, numerical identity and diversity, individuality and persistence of things of any kind, biological individuality and organisational closure. Selves are self and persons are personhood (group: philosophy; ADR-015, ADR-024).

| [CASE-045](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-045.md) v4 | Measuring the dancing couple: is the pair a nearly decomposable block during the dance and not after it? | A proposed study, not run. Motion-capture several couples dancing an improvised partner dance to recorded music, and record the same people standing and talking after the song. Fit a linear model to the joint kinematics, with the music's beat as an exogenous input. Then ask whether the pair is a block whose gap beats its Occam factor during the dance and not after, whether it compensates under a perturbation, and whether the coupling runs both ways. | Active |
| [CASE-054](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-054.md) v2 | Joking relationships: one kind among the Crow and in Africa with no route between them, descended between Crow and Hidatsa, and a transported tale beside them | Radcliffe-Brown defined the joking relationship as one comparative kind and placed the Crow joking-relative and Dogon and Thonga joking in it; no historical route joins the Crow to West or South-East Africa. Lowie records the same institution among the Hidatsa, a division of the Crow's parent tribe, and Tehrani's phylogeny confirms an Ibo "Little Red Riding Hood" as an oral translation of the European tale. Kind without transport, kind with descent, and a transport, on documented material, for [CLAIM-210](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-210.md). Partial: independence is a fact of geography no source states, and the kind is an analyst's. | Active |
| [CASE-057](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-057.md) | Swapping the two persons of a dyad: nonreciprocal T/V address is changed by the swap and reciprocal address is not, with a constructed French–English dyad and a three-person teasing round | Built on a documented distinction. In Brown and Gilman's account of T/V address, power address is nonreciprocal (the superior says T and receives V) and solidarity address is reciprocal, so swapping the two persons changes the first act and leaves the second fixed. Two constructions extend it. A master-and-servant dyad in French and in modern English is changed by the swap in one realization and fixed by it in the other. A three-person teasing round gives a group whose automorphism can swap characters, so the anchoring of [CLAIM-249](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-249.md) has work to do. | Active |
| [CASE-060](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-060.md) | Two identical unnumbered ballots in one tally: two votes that no relation in the structure of the vote tells apart | Constructed: two voters each put a single cross for the same candidate on identical, unnumbered ballot papers in one box, and both are counted. Within the relations that make a paper a vote, each bears the same relations to everything and none to the other, so they are not even weakly discernible, yet the count is two. Anchored on a documented norm that voids any paper marked so that the voter can be identified (UK RPA 1983, Sch. 1, r. 47(1)(c)). It forces the choice between [CLAIM-136](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-136.md)'s strict and weak versions, and bears on [CLAIM-138](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-138.md). | Active |

| [CASE-105](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-105.md) | The Washington Senators: the original club became the Minnesota Twins in 1961, an expansion club took its name in Washington and became the Texas Rangers in 1972, and the Montreal Expos became the Washington Nationals in 2005, so franchise, city and supporters each have a different successor | The owner's subcase at U2 of the exchange of 2026-10-16, "the team formerly known as the washington senators". | [CASE-111](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-111.md) | A fold in boundary maintenance: in ḃ = μb + κb² − b³ with cooperative repair (κ > 0), an unmaintained and a maintained state are both stable for −κ²/4 < μ < 0, so maintenance lost past the fold is not restored by returning the parameter, and recovery slows to zero as the fold nears | A7 §4 of the exchange of 2026-10-17, after the owner's "flesh this out further": a normal form for the activity b that maintains a boundary, in which repair processes reinforce one another. | [CASE-121](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-121.md) | One melody from a 1951 gospel record to a 2005 Katrina protest song: "I've Got a Savior", "I Got a Woman", "Gold Digger" and "George Bush Doesn't Care About Black People", each link a different relation, the message turned at every step | Boyle's chain in The Public Domain, ch. 6 ([LIT-1301](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1301.md)).
